items.title: Manuel "Fess" Manetta and Edward "Kid" Ory Interview, 1958-08-26
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] How old were you, Ren Bold, and heard you?

ctx.x: He said, would you like to play with me? I said, very much so. I said, wait a minute. I ran back in the kitchen in the sister's back. I said, oh, that one made a wife. And boy, I was so happy. He said, no, you have to go back home and go to school. You promised your dad he was on the staff there in the 21. And when it was 21, 4 o'clock in the morning and 8 o'clock I was on the train. I've been gone ever since. Well, I was playing professionally, playing dances, you know. Oh, yeah, sure. That was about 18 then.…
How old were you, Ren Bold, and heard you?
Well, I was about 18 then. Well, I was playing professionally, playing dances, you know.
